stories.title: Public Health Wales survey reveals scale of child poverty across Wales
stories.summary: Nearly one in three children in Wales were living in poverty in 2023-24, according to Department for Work and Pensions figures cited in research published by Public Health Wales. stories.title: Petitions against Saltney and Mold school closure plans to be handed to Flintshire Council this week
stories.summary: Petitions from parents, pupils and staff opposed to plans to close two primary schools will be handed over to Flintshire County Council this week. stories.title: Luxury bridal room and outdoor wedding service area added to Soughton Hall plans
stories.summary: Plans for a permanent new wedding venue at historic Soughton Hall have been updated to include an outdoor wedding venue space and more luxurious bridal room. stories.title: HMRC reminds millions of Self Assessment taxpayers of 31 July payment deadline
stories.summary: Millions of Self Assessment taxpayers have one month to prepare for a payment deadline, HM Revenue and Customs has warned.
